doc: Read a 3D rigid world's bodies, joints, characters and what touched what, cast a ray or a shape into it, push a body, drive a joint's motor, walk and jump a character, step it, return to a frame, and ask what would be.

tools.name: rigid3.observe
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, how many bodies (and how many awake), joints and characters, and what began and ended touching in the last step (a sensor's overlaps marked `sensor`)

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: contacts are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: rigid3.bodies
tools.description: Each body's id, kind, place, turn, velocity and whether it is awake, in the order made

tools.name: rigid3.ray
tools.description: The first body a segment meets: which, how far along, where and the surface's normal there

tools.name: rigid3.cast
tools.description: The first body a shape swept along a segment meets: which, how far along, where and the surface's normal there

radius.description: sphere, capsule: m (0.5 when none is given)

half.description: box: [x, y, z], its half extents

half_height.description: capsule: half the length of its middle, along y (0.5 when none is given)

from.description: [x, y, z], where the shape's centre starts

to.description: [x, y, z], where it would end

tools.name: rigid3.joints
tools.description: Each joint's id, form, bodies (0: the world), value (a hinge's angle, a slider's place, a distance joint's length) and motor, in the order made

tools.name: rigid3.drive
tools.description: A hinge's or a slider's motor, from the next step: off, toward a speed, or toward an angle or a place
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the world: the motor drives from the next step

target.description: rad/s or m/s (velocity), rad or m (position)

tools.name: rigid3.move
tools.description: A character's walk, from the next step until told otherwise: up steps and the slopes it can climb, stuck to the floor going down
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the world: the character walks from the next step

velocity.description: [x, y, z] in m/s; y is left to gravity and jumps

tools.name: rigid3.jump
tools.description: A character's jump on the next step, when it stands on the ground (the answer says whether it does now)
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the world and see where it lands

speed.description: m/s upward (5 when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.where
tools.description: Where a character is (or every one): its feet, its velocity and walk, and what it stands on

character.description: the character's id (every one when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.ground
tools.description: What each character stood on after the last step, in the order of their ids: on the ground, on steep ground, not supported or in the air, and which body

tools.name: rigid3.push
tools.description: An impulse on a body, given on the next step: through its centre of mass, or at a point in the world
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the world: the push acts on the next step

at.description: [x, y, z], where in the world it is given (its centre of mass when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.step
tools.undo: rigid3.seek to the frame it began at

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: rigid3.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept, bit for bit (a checkpoint and the pushes since, played again); what is stepped from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the world: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the world at the frame returned to

tools.name: rigid3.branch
tools.description: What would be: the world some steps ahead, a body pushed first if one is given, observed as rigid3.observe does; the world itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

tasks.name: see-what-is-there
tasks.summary: Read the bodies, then what lies straight down from above

tasks.name: push-and-watch
tasks.summary: Push a body, step the world, and read what it struck

tasks.name: walk-a-character
tasks.summary: Walk a character, step, and read where it stands

tasks.name: turn-a-motor
tasks.summary: Read the joints, drive a hinge's motor, step, and read its angle

tasks.name: ask-before-pushing
tasks.summary: See what a push would do some steps ahead, the world itself untouched
